summary: Froze the aom ecosystem scope and install/stage-is-not-activation invariant for AgentOS artifact lifecycle.
acceptance_evidence: runtime-ecosystem-architecture.md states that staged artifacts must be inert and that active artifacts must be recoverable and explainable.

runtime-ecosystem-architecture.md defines the activation boundary: aom activate must not mutate runtime state directly and must produce AgentCore PlanSpec plus SecurityExecutionEngine-mediated effects.
The first implementation slice is frozen to policy-pack, workflow-pack and test-replay-pack.
Deferred artifact kinds are listed: capability-pack, semantic-tool-pack, model-profile-pack, knowledge-pack, runtime-adapter-pack, execution-image-pack and trust-metadata-pack.
Community artifacts are sandbox-only by default and local-dev artifacts are not production-promotable by default.

commands.summary: Confirmed required first artifact kinds, inert staging, activation boundary and community/local-dev restrictions are present.

blocked_shortcuts: No install or stage operation may activate runtime behavior.
No artifact activation may bypass AgentCore PlanSpec and SecurityExecutionEngine.
No public marketplace or network registry is required for baseline.
No community or local-dev artifact is production-promotable by default.
promotion_impact: Starts Wave 3 by freezing aom as a local-first AgentOS artifact ecosystem with inert staging and runtime-mediated activation.
